stops.note: from the first day to a coffin in Egypt
slavery, the plagues, the sea, and the mountain
the covenant sealed, and Moses goes up into the cloud
the calf, the broken tablets, and the second pair
the quail, Miriam, and the spies who came back afraid
Korah, and the rod that budded
Meribah, the bronze serpent, and Balaam's donkey
the daughters of Zelophehad, and Joshua commissioned
Midian, and the tribes who asked to stay east of the river
Moses dies within sight of it
the river, the walls, and the long day
the altar by the Jordan, and Joshua's last words
the cycle, twelve times, and no king in Israel
a famine, a field, and a redeemer
Samuel, Saul, and the shepherd who was anointed
the kingdom, the roof, and the son in the oak
the temple, the divided kingdom, and Elijah
Elisha to the exile
the same reign, told again for people coming home
the temple, and the kings measured against it
the return, and the second foundation
the wall, in fifty-two days
a banquet, an edict, and a queen who went in unasked
the wager, and everything taken in one afternoon
the frame closes: he sees, and it is given back
the court stories: the furnace, the writing, the lions
a man running the other way
from the upper room to a rented house in Rome
